profiles.directive: Use a frontal viewpoint at subject height with the camera level. Let the arrangement follow the scene rather than forcing symmetry.
View the subject from one side at approximately eye level, with visible depth and an oblique perspective. Keep the camera level.
Use an elevated, oblique viewpoint looking downward across the subject. Keep perspective coherent and the camera level.
Use a lower viewpoint looking slightly upward and across the subject from one side. Keep perspective coherent and the camera level.
Use an oblique viewpoint with a gentle counterclockwise camera roll of about six degrees. Compose the scene with that angle during generation, with coherent perspective throughout.
Use a slightly elevated, oblique viewpoint with a gentle clockwise camera roll of about six degrees. Compose the scene with that angle during generation, with coherent perspective throughout.
